audit.why: The lane read — yours until his E, his from 3 onward, yours again on the lethality spike — matches a 675-range melee with one pull and no dash.
audit.corrected: Read stands; the pull's cooldown was the missing anchor.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 and level 6 spikes name the abilities but not their cooldowns.
audit.why: Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s and Realm of Death is 140/120/100s. A 16-second pull means most of the wave is free; a 140-second ult means one dodged Realm buys you two full minutes.
audit.corrected: Step up on Death's Grasp downtime (16s at rank 1); a spent Realm of Death (140s at rank 1) is your window to take the lane back.

audit.whatIsWrong: His E is called 'Death Grasp' and Indestructible is only described as banking shield.
audit.why: The ability is Death's Grasp. Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s) stores damage he deals AND takes, then can be consumed as a heal — so Grievous Wounds applied before he converts it is what makes your chip stick.
audit.corrected: Death's Grasp is the pull; Indestructible converts stored damage into a heal, so land anti-heal before he cashes it.

edits.before: His E (Death Grasp) pull comes online and the lane flips: it yanks you off the wave into an isolated Obliterate slam while his W banks half that damage back as shield-health.
edits.after: His E (Death's Grasp, 16s) comes online and the lane flips: it yanks you off the wave into an isolated Obliterate while Indestructible banks half that damage back as shield.

edits.after: Realm of Death (140s at rank 1) drops you into a walled 1v1 and steals your stats — a duel his sustain wins and your range can't refuse, so never be caught solo with it up.

edits.before: "Levels 1-3 are yours until he hits E. At 2 your passive's second shot plus Avengerang out-chip his slow, single-target Obliterate, and short Q-auto trades come out even or better because your third-stack shield eats his return damage. The danger arrives at 3: Death Grasp pulls you off the wave into an isolated Obliterate slam, and his W banks roughly half that exchange back as shield-health and a heal. Stand on top of your minions so the pull has nothing to drag you onto, and last-hit at boomerang range rather than walking into auto range."
edits.after: "Levels 1-3 are yours until he hits E. At 2 your passive's second shot plus Avengerang out-chip his slow, single-target Obliterate, and short Q-auto trades come out even or better because your third-stack shield eats his return damage. The danger arrives at 3: Death's Grasp (16s at rank 1) pulls you off the wave into an isolated Obliterate, and Indestructible banks roughly half that exchange back as shield-health he can convert to a heal. Stand on top of your minions so the pull has nothing to drag you onto, and last-hit at boomerang range."

edits.before: "Levels 4-6 he ranks Q and isolated Obliterate hits start to bite — hug the wave all lane and never hand him a clean Death Grasp. Keep Heroic Swing strictly for his engage, not for tempo: when his E is down he can't reach you and you Q-auto-string him for free. At 6 Realm of Death is the button you respect above all — it walls you into a 1v1 and steals a chunk of your stats, the one fight your range can't kite out of, so don't be alone with his R up. Trade only when his E is on cooldown, and bait the Realm before you ever commit."
edits.after: "Levels 4-6 he ranks Q and isolated Obliterate hits start to bite — hug the wave all lane and never hand him a clean Death's Grasp. Keep Heroic Swing strictly for his engage, not for tempo: on the pull's 16 seconds of downtime he can't reach you and you Q-auto-string him for free. At 6 Realm of Death is the button you respect above all — it walls you into a 1v1 and steals your stats, the one fight your range can't kite out of. Trade only when his E is down, and never stand alone with a 140s R up."
